revisit.resolution: First native image emission appeared at a tiny display extent. One revisit of the exact original displayed the whole native image and confirmed complete glyph readings; the date visually contains gaps around its extended midline dash.
revisit.reason: Confirm native typography after limited first native display.

observations.observation: The Korean title is the largest verbal element; the explanation becomes a tiny two-line caption. This reverses the assigned explanation-led hierarchy.

observations.location: upper-left paragraph and central visit/access rows
observations.observation: Paragraph and lower ledger characters are visibly small, around 10px and below, although dark on light paper. Full explanation and visit details require focused reading.
Large right tree, center blue pot, left broad-leaf clay pot, attached stems/veins, soil and visible branching root cutaway express living scale and repotting. The large canopy enters the crop.
Bench boards, stool, cloth, books and greenhouse wall dressing organize a scene; independent specimens and a horizontal open atlas ground are weaker than assigned.
Market start sits below the paragraph but its left start is displaced right, creating a hanging title rather than the requested common entry axis.
Date shows an extended midline dash with visibly separated surrounding gaps. First raw transcription retains those gaps.

style.checked_requirement: Explanation-led colored-pencil/fine-ink botanical atlas with independent specimens and horizontal ground ledger
style.observed: Botanical illustration and plant scale are substantial; title dominance, small explanation and scenic furniture weaken assigned organization.
issues: Scenic furniture and background replace open atlas ground.

ratio.observation: Height is nearest-integer rounding of exact 940.5; permitted policy, no resize.

substantive_visual.observation: Three different living scales, pot/soil anatomy and root cutaway occupy a substantive whole plant field.

hangul.observation: Book-serif syllable bodies and open counters mostly stable at native; useful word boundaries visible. Small explanation/access/invitation bodies lose comfortable presence at 720.

information_relationship.observation: Date/hours/venue horizontal row with succeeding access/care and invitation/URL; these remain local. Paragraph-market start alignment is offset.

function_contact.observation: URL is present and legible at native; no QR requested or added; no actual interaction test applies to flat raster.

material_edges.observation: Fine veins, attached branches and root cutaway retained; substantial colored-pencil/ink rendering with watercolor-like pot grain. Some background foliage is crowded; no blank or transparent margin.

residuals: Explanation-led hierarchy not implemented: large Korean title dominates.
Full paragraph and lower useful ledger are small at 720 width.
Date range spacing differs in first observed reading.
Scenic benches/stool/books/cloth and wall dressing dilute independent atlas ground.
Market entry does not share paragraph's starting axis.
